newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates unchanged, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates unchanged, seen steady.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates stayed unchanged on Tuesday on buying by mills amid shortage of ready stocks and dealers said prices would remain pegged to these levels as arrival of fresh supplies was slow.

"For the time being there are little chances that the prices would ease because the supply of new (1997/98 July-June) crop has not fully picked up," dealer Kishan Chand said. "If there are rains in Sindh province, the price would climb further."
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted around 2,200 ($54.16) rupees per maund (37.32 kg).
